about: What the U.S. Constitution requires of a candidate for a federal office, whatever the state's own age for its statewide offices says. The office is the last part of its id (office:US-RI:us-senate, office:US:president). The House's 25 is in filing-fallbacks.json and the state rows, which already read it.

us-senate.citation: U.S. Const. art. I, sec. 3, cl. 3 (nine years a citizen; an inhabitant of the state chosen)

president.citation: U.S. Const. art. II, sec. 1, cl. 5 (a natural-born citizen, fourteen years a resident)
